paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for two models, Llama4 Scout and Llama4 Maverick, on a 5-digit multiplication task, as described in the paper "Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback." The x-axis represents "Initial Confidence," ranging from 0.95 to 0.99 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents "Accuracy," ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays three lines: "Final Acc" (blue line with circular markers and solid line style), "Δ Acc" (orange line with diamond markers and dashed line style), and "Initial Acc" (green line with square markers and dashed line style). The "Final Acc" line starts at approximately 0.89 and ends at approximately 0.86, showing a slight overall decline. The "Δ Acc" line starts at approximately 0.89, peaks at approximately 0.90, and ends at approximately 0.77. The "Initial Acc" line starts at 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.15, showing a steady upward trend. All lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
